summary: Embeddings endpoint timeouts in eu-west (prod) for enterprise customer
description:
## Issue summary
Enterprise customer reports intermittent request timeouts on the Embeddings endpoint in **eu-west**. Symptoms present as client-side timeouts (30s) and occasional gateway 504s. Customer indicates impact to production document ingestion pipeline.

## Impact
- **Customer impact:** Elevated latency/timeouts for embeddings requests; ingestion workers backing up.
- **Scope (initial):** Customer-reported, suspected broader eu-west degradation.
- **Business impact:** Enterprise account; risk of SLA breach/credits request if sustained.

## Customer context
- Company: Vertex Legaltech (Enterprise)
- Workload: batch embeddings (typically 64–256 inputs/request)
- Notable constraint: ingestion pipeline is region-pinned to eu-west for data residency.

## Environment
- Tier: Enterprise (Hosted API)
- Region: eu-west
- Endpoint: /v1/embeddings
- SDK: customer states Python SDK 1.12.x (exact patch unknown)

## Timeline (UTC)
- 2026-02-11 10:12: Customer email via Support portal: "embeddings timing out in EU region"
- 10:18: SUP-1850 created, triage started
- 10:22: Requested required intake fields (request IDs, timestamps, model, payload sizes)
- 10:29: First response sent (ack + comms cadence)
- 10:41: Error/latency checks indicate elevated p95 in eu-west embeddings
- 10:47: Escalated to SRE per trigger (Sev1) + opened incident bridge
- 11:05: Mitigation applied: route a % of embeddings traffic to alternate eu-west pool; recommended customer-side timeout/retry settings
- 11:32: Metrics stabilize; customer confirms improved success rate
- 2026-02-12 09:10: Continued monitoring shows stable; incident closed

## Intake checklist (requested / collected)
Requested from customer (per Support intake checklist):
- Region (confirmed eu-west)
- Model (text-embedding-3-large; also saw bge-large-en-v1.5)
- SDK + runtime (Python SDK ~1.12.x; running in Kubernetes)
- Request IDs (received 3 IDs; see internal note in comments)
- Approx payload sizes (64–256 strings; some up to ~5–8k chars)
- Time window + timezone (provided UTC timestamps)

## Triage notes (Support)
- Customer reports client-side timeout at 30 seconds; also observes sporadic 504s.
- No auth errors; no 429s. Not consistent with quota/rate limiting.
- Suspect regional capacity saturation or upstream dependency (vectorization workers) latency.

## Escalation trigger (per new playbook draft)
Escalate to SRE immediately (P1/Sev1) when any of the following are true:
- Regional p95 latency on embeddings exceeds customer-observed timeouts (>30s) for >10 minutes, OR
- 5xx rate >1% for embeddings in a region for >5 minutes with at least 1 enterprise customer impact, OR
- Multiple customers report the same symptom in the same region.

## Customer comms plan (Enterprise cadence)
Per SLA policy draft for enterprise incidents:
- **Initial acknowledgement:** within 15 minutes (met at 10:29 UTC)
- **Updates:** every 60 minutes while investigating, or within 30 minutes of major changes (mitigation applied, root cause confirmed, resolution)
- **Status page:** only if confirmed broad customer impact beyond a single account and sustained degradation; coordinate with #incidents and comms alignment doc.

## Interim workaround guidance provided to customer
- Increase client timeout to 60s temporarily for embeddings requests.
- Enable retries with exponential backoff on network timeouts/504s (max 2 retries) and log request IDs.
- If ingestion can tolerate it, reduce batch size per request (e.g., 64 inputs) while issue persists.
- If customer can temporarily fail over, consider routing to us-east (customer declined due to residency).

## Resolution
SRE applied a mitigation in eu-west to reduce queuing delay for embeddings workers and adjusted routing to rebalance load across pools. Latency returned to normal and timeouts ceased.

## Follow-ups
- Confirm whether this incident should generate a short known-issue entry (if recurrence observed) vs handled as one-off.
- Ensure canonical embeddings health dashboard link is included in Support quick-view set (see ENG-4823).
- Add clearer customer-facing error classification for gateway timeouts on embeddings (if feasible) to reduce ambiguity (request ID + retryable hint).
